behavior: Eligibility comes only from backend saved-acknowledgement capability, never provider observation.
Explicit trimmed bounded reason and second confirmation; one exact UUID/digest/reason body retained after uncertainty.
Manual same-request replay only; 401/403/404/409/422 require explicit detail reload first; 503/network/malformed response retain original pending body.
In-memory pending cache is keyed to ApiClient authentication generation, bounded to 32 and refuses admission instead of evicting uncertain entries.
Whole action detail reload updates status, header and receipt coherently; no local completion patch from POST or provider observation.
Safe validated saved record displays actual actor, time, reason and status; acceptance is not delivery or payload correctness.
limitations: Synthetic API promises and existing minimal hook scheduler exercise actual components/AuthProvider/API code; no browser or React concurrency qualification.
No provider, send, production database, migration, or live recipient actions were performed for these UI checks.
No cross-tab, browser restart or persistent pending-request guarantee; cache is memory only.
Credential token changes intentionally invalidate the prior auth generation's pending state; no localStorage recovery payload.
